{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_filtered = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the number of such customers
n_new_paid_search = len(df_filtered)

# Count how many of them converted
n_converted = df_filtered['converted'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_new_paid_search

# Return results
n_new_paid_search, n_converted, fraction_converted"}
